verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
“Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
lines: “Can a man be profitable to God?
Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

verses.text: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
lines: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous?
Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

verses.text: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
lines: Is it for your piety that he reproves you,
that he enters with you into judgment?

verses.text: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
lines: Isn’t your wickedness great?
Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

verses.text: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
lines: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing,
and stripped the naked of their clothing.

verses.text: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
lines: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink,
and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

verses.text: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
lines: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth.
The honorable man, he lived in it.

verses.text: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
lines: You have sent widows away empty,
and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

verses.text: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
lines: Therefore snares are around you.
Sudden fear troubles you,

verses.text: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
lines: or darkness, so that you can not see,
and floods of waters cover you.

verses.text: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
lines: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven?
See the height of the stars, how high they are!

verses.text: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
lines: You say, ‘What does God know?
Can he judge through the thick darkness?

verses.text: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
lines: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see.
He walks on the vault of the sky.’

verses.text: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
lines: Will you keep the old way,
which wicked men have trodden,

verses.text: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
lines: who were snatched away before their time,
whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

verses.text: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
lines: who said to God, ‘Depart from us;’
and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

verses.text: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
lines: Yet he filled their houses with good things,
but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

verses.text: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
lines: The righteous see it, and are glad.
The innocent ridicule them,

verses.text: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
lines: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off.
The fire has consumed their remnant.’

verses.text: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
lines: “Acquaint yourself with him, now, and be at peace.
By it, good will come to you.

verses.text: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
lines: Please receive instruction from his mouth,
and lay up his words in your heart.

verses.text: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
lines: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up,
if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

verses.text: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
lines: Lay your treasure in the dust,
the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

verses.text: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
lines: The Almighty will be your treasure,
and precious silver to you.

verses.text: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
lines: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty,
and will lift up your face to God.

verses.text: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
lines: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you.
You will pay your vows.

verses.text: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
lines: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you.
Light will shine on your ways.

verses.text: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
lines: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’
He will save the humble person.

verses.text: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
lines: He will even deliver him who is not innocent.
Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
